designationHistory.indexText: Bond Swamp National Wildlife Refuge was established on the Ocmulgee River floodplain near Macon, Georgia, through work by the Fish and Wildlife Service and The Nature Conservancy.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956; Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986
